edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 20 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 根据11月20日订阅邮件 Today’s top stories 七则短讯依原始顺序改写，21道词汇与搭配练习。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.meaning_zh: 对人工智能前景感到不安
items.example: Global technology investors remained uneasy about artificial intelligence even after Anthropic's enormous stock-market debut.
items.analysis_zh: uneasy about 指对某事感到忧虑，about 引出忧虑对象。这里描写投资者对人工智能估值的谨慎态度，不能据此断言他们反对技术本身。与 nervous about 相比，uneasy 更强调持续的不踏实；remain 后接形容词构成系表结构。
items.cloze: Global technology investors remained ______ about artificial intelligence even after Anthropic's enormous stock-market debut.
items.hint_zh: 对人工智能前景感到不安
items.why_zh: remained uneasy about artificial intelligence 在本句中表示“对人工智能仍感到不安”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设新项目成本波动引发担忧
imitation.sentence_en: The planning team remained uneasy about volatile material costs.
imitation.translation_zh: 计划团队仍对原材料成本波动感到担忧。

context.zh: 对人工智能仍感到不安

items.example: Shares across major Asian and European markets slipped as concerns about valuations spread.
items.analysis_zh: slip 在市场报道中表示价格温和下滑，常用 shares slipped 或 prices slipped。这里同时交代市场走势和投资者对估值的担忧，但 as 只能提示时间或可能的因果关联。与 plunge 相比，slip 不暗示暴跌；过去式 slipped 表示已发生的行情。
items.cloze: Shares across major Asian and European markets ______ as concerns about valuations spread.
items.why_zh: markets slipped as concerns 在本句中表示“随着担忧蔓延，市场下跌”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应商报价小幅下调
imitation.sentence_en: The quoted price slipped after another round of negotiations.
imitation.translation_zh: 又一轮谈判后，报价小幅下降。

context.zh: 随着担忧蔓延，市场下跌

items.example: Despite the broader sell-off, Anthropic's first-day closing price valued the company at nearly $1.3trn.
items.analysis_zh: value something at an amount 是金融报道中表示按某价格给资产估值的结构，at 后接具体金额。这里依据上市首日收盘股价计算公司市值，未表明其基本面价值已经得到证实。与 worth 不同，valued 是及物动词，可直接带估值对象。
items.cloze: Despite the broader sell-off, Anthropic's first-day closing price ______ the company at nearly $1.3trn.
items.why_zh: valued the company at nearly $1.3trn 在本句中表示“使该公司的估值接近1.3万亿美元”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设分析一项收购
imitation.sentence_en: Analysts valued the target company at $400m.
imitation.translation_zh: 分析师将目标公司的估值定为4亿美元。

context.zh: 使该公司的估值接近1.3万亿美元

items.example: European leaders signalled a willingness to discuss a possible end to the war in Ukraine after an invitation from Vladimir Putin.
items.analysis_zh: signal a willingness to do something 表示通过言行释放意愿信号，to 后接动词原形。这里仅反映欧洲领导人的谈判姿态，尚无协议或谈判结果。与 promise 相比，signal 不构成正式承诺，适合外交报道谨慎描述立场。
items.cloze: European leaders ______ a willingness to discuss a possible end to the war in Ukraine after an invitation from Vladimir Putin.
items.why_zh: leaders signalled a willingness 在本句中表示“领导人释放了愿意参与的信号”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合作商表达合作兴趣
imitation.sentence_en: The distributor signalled a willingness to review the contract.
imitation.translation_zh: 经销商表示愿意重新审阅合同。

context.zh: 领导人释放了愿意参与的信号

items.example: Putin had invited the leaders to Moscow to clarify their positions on a settlement.
items.analysis_zh: invite somebody to a place 表示邀请某人前往某地，后面的 to clarify 说明目的。这里是俄方提出邀请，不能据此推断欧洲领导人已经接受。had invited 使用过去完成时，标示邀请发生在随后表态之前。
items.cloze: Putin had ______ the leaders to Moscow to clarify their positions on a settlement.
items.why_zh: invited the leaders to Moscow 在本句中表示“邀请这些领导人前往莫斯科”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设邀请合作方参加评审
imitation.sentence_en: The project manager invited suppliers to Shenzhen for a technical review.
imitation.translation_zh: 项目经理邀请供应商到深圳参加技术评审。

context.zh: 邀请这些领导人前往莫斯科

items.example: Poland's prime minister criticised the friendly tone of the earlier meeting involving Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.
items.analysis_zh: criticise something 表示明确提出批评，宾语是会谈展现的友好氛围，而非对所有与会者作全面定性。这里是波兰总理的公开立场，应与客观会谈事实区分。英式拼写 criticised 与美式 criticized 等价；criticise for 则用于指出具体过错。
items.cloze: Poland's prime minister ______ the friendly tone of the earlier meeting involving Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.
items.why_zh: criticised the friendly tone 在本句中表示“批评了友好的语气”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设评审会上质疑计划
imitation.sentence_en: The auditor criticised the optimistic delivery assumptions.
imitation.translation_zh: 审核员批评了过于乐观的交付假设。

context.zh: 批评了友好的语气

items.example: A congressional committee said the administration had approved exports of advanced chips to firms linked by the Pentagon to China's military.
items.analysis_zh: approve exports of something 表示正式批准某类货物出口，of 后引出商品。had approved 使用过去完成时突出审批早于国会披露。报道中的军事关联属于五角大楼的认定，不能自动等同于已由法院确认的违法交易；authorise 是语义接近的英式替代。
items.cloze: A congressional committee said the administration had ______ exports of advanced chips to firms linked by the Pentagon to China's military.
items.why_zh: had approved exports of advanced chips 在本句中表示“此前批准了先进芯片出口”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设设备出口需要许可
imitation.sentence_en: The regulator approved exports of the laboratory equipment.
imitation.translation_zh: 监管机构批准了实验室设备出口。

context.en: had approved exports of advanced chips
context.zh: 此前批准了先进芯片出口

items.example: A short-seller separately alleged that restricted Chinese organisations could still obtain AMD technology.
items.analysis_zh: allege that 引出尚待证实的指控，尤其适用于法律和调查语境。这里明确指控来自做空机构，不能当作已核实事实；与 prove that 有明显证据强度差异。过去式 alleged 只表述指控行为已发生，不表示指控成立。
items.cloze: A short-seller separately ______ that restricted Chinese organisations could still obtain AMD technology.
items.why_zh: separately alleged that restricted Chinese organisations 在本句中表示“另行指称受限制的中国机构”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设有人指控供应商违反条款
imitation.sentence_en: A competitor alleged that the supplier had breached the agreement.
imitation.translation_zh: 一家竞争对手声称该供应商违反了协议。

context.en: separately alleged that restricted Chinese organisations
context.zh: 另行指称受限制的中国机构

items.example: AMD denied wrongdoing as its shares fell following the allegations.
items.analysis_zh: deny wrongdoing 是报道公司回应指控的固定搭配，deny 后直接接名词或动名词，不能写成 deny to do。这里仅记录公司的否认立场，不据此判断指控真伪。与 dispute an allegation 相比，deny wrongdoing 更明确否认存在违规行为。
items.cloze: AMD ______ wrongdoing as its shares fell following the allegations.
items.why_zh: denied wrongdoing 在本句中表示“否认存在不当行为”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合作方回应合规质疑
imitation.sentence_en: The manufacturer denied wrongdoing during the compliance review.
imitation.translation_zh: 制造商在合规审查期间否认存在不当行为。

context.zh: 否认存在不当行为

items.example: The US Senate rejected a proposal intended to restrict the president's conduct of the war in Iran.
items.analysis_zh: reject a proposal 是议会和商业决策报道中的常见搭配，表示正式否决提议。这里反映投票结果，不能延伸为参议院批准所有后续军事行动。与 postpone 不同，reject 意味着本次提案未获通过；过去式 rejected 指向已完成的表决。
items.cloze: The US Senate ______ a proposal intended to restrict the president's conduct of the war in Iran.
items.why_zh: Senate rejected a proposal 在本句中表示“参议院否决了一项提案”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目委员会否决预算方案
imitation.sentence_en: The steering committee rejected the revised budget proposal.
imitation.translation_zh: 指导委员会否决了修订后的预算方案。

context.zh: 参议院否决了一项提案

items.example: The measure would require either an end to hostilities or explicit congressional approval for continuing them.
items.analysis_zh: require something 表示规定或强制要求，would require 描述未通过法案原本拟产生的法律效果。either ... or ... 并列两个替代方案，必须保持语法平行。与 suggest 相比，require 带有约束力，但此处法案遭否决，因此该要求尚未生效。
items.cloze: The measure would ______ either an end to hostilities or explicit congressional approval for continuing them.
items.why_zh: would require either an end to hostilities 在本句中表示“将要求结束敌对行动或采取另一选项”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同设置两种履约方式
imitation.sentence_en: The agreement would require either advance payment or a bank guarantee.
imitation.translation_zh: 协议将要求预付款或银行保函二选一。

context.en: would require either an end to hostilities
context.zh: 将要求结束敌对行动或采取另一选项

items.example: Critics argued that the administration had largely bypassed lawmakers when pursuing the conflict.
items.analysis_zh: bypass lawmakers 表示绕过立法机关的参与或审议，largely 限定程度，避免绝对化。这里是批评者的判断，应保留 Critics argued that 的归因。过去完成时 had bypassed 指向此前一段行动；与 consult lawmakers 相反，bypass 强调未按通常程序充分征询。
items.cloze: Critics argued that the administration had largely ______ lawmakers when pursuing the conflict.
items.why_zh: had largely bypassed lawmakers 在本句中表示“在很大程度上绕过了立法者”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设团队绕过审批流程
imitation.sentence_en: The team bypassed the normal approval process to meet a deadline.
imitation.translation_zh: 团队为赶上截止日期绕过了正常审批流程。

context.zh: 在很大程度上绕过了立法者

items.example: President Nayib Bukele announced his candidacy for a third term in El Salvador.
items.analysis_zh: announce one's candidacy for a position 表示正式宣布参选某职位，for 后接目标职位或任期。这里仅是参选声明，不能写成已经连任。与 presidency 不同，candidacy 指候选人身份或竞选资格；第三任期的表述反映其政治目标。
items.cloze: President Nayib Bukele announced his ______ for a third term in El Salvador.
items.why_zh: announced his candidacy for a third term 在本句中表示“宣布竞选第三个任期”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设员工参加委员会选举
imitation.sentence_en: She announced her candidacy for the employee council.
imitation.translation_zh: 她宣布竞选员工委员会席位。

context.en: announced his candidacy for a third term
context.zh: 宣布竞选第三个任期

items.example: Constitutional changes under his government removed the previous two-term presidential limit.
items.analysis_zh: remove a limit 表示废除既有上限，宾语是具体制度约束。这里陈述宪法变动的效果，并不自动证明其程序获得所有政治派别认可。与 suspend 不同，remove 更强调规则被撤销；previous 限定所指的是旧制度。
items.cloze: Constitutional changes under his government ______ the previous two-term presidential limit.
items.why_zh: removed the previous two-term presidential limit 在本句中表示“取消了此前的总统两届任期限制”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设采购流程取消最低订货量
imitation.sentence_en: The revised contract removed the minimum-order requirement.
imitation.translation_zh: 修订后的合同取消了最低订货量要求。

context.en: removed the previous two-term presidential limit
context.zh: 取消了此前的总统两届任期限制

items.example: Although critics describe his rule as authoritarian, some people across the Americas have admired his crackdown on crime.
items.analysis_zh: admire somebody's crackdown on something 表示赞赏其强力打击行动，on 引出打击对象。although 构成让步结构，把对执政方式的批评与部分公众对治安政策的评价并置。现在完成时 have admired 说明这种评价持续至今，并不意味着普遍支持。
items.cloze: Although critics describe his rule as authoritarian, some people across the Americas have ______ his crackdown on crime.
items.why_zh: have admired his crackdown on crime 在本句中表示“一直赞赏他的打击犯罪行动”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设团队赞赏风险管控
imitation.sentence_en: Several managers admired the team's firm response to recurring defects.
imitation.translation_zh: 几位经理赞赏团队对反复缺陷采取的坚定应对。

context.en: have admired his crackdown on crime
context.zh: 一直赞赏他的打击犯罪行动

items.example: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in 2017.
items.analysis_zh: commit genocide against a group 是国际法中描述针对特定群体实施种族灭绝的严肃结构，against 指明受害群体。这里依据国际法院裁决陈述法律认定，不应随意以一般暴力或迫害替换 genocide，因为法律构成要件更严格。
items.cloze: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed ______ against the Rohingya minority in 2017.
items.why_zh: committed genocide against the Rohingya minority 在本句中表示“对罗兴亚少数族群实施了种族灭绝”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设讨论国际法案例
imitation.sentence_en: The seminar examined how courts establish intent in cases of genocide.
imitation.translation_zh: 研讨会讨论法院如何在种族灭绝案件中认定意图。

context.en: committed genocide against the Rohingya minority
context.zh: 对罗兴亚少数族群实施了种族灭绝

items.example: Hundreds of thousands of Rohingya fled their homes and crossed into Bangladesh during the military campaign.
items.analysis_zh: flee one's home 表示因危险被迫逃离住所，fled 是 flee 的过去式，后面可直接接地点而不加 from。这里描述2017年军事行动造成的难民流动，不能把逃亡理解为自愿迁居。与 migrate 相比，flee 强调紧迫威胁。
items.cloze: Hundreds of thousands of Rohingya ______ their homes and crossed into Bangladesh during the military campaign.
items.why_zh: fled their homes 在本句中表示“逃离了他们的家园”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设描述自然灾害疏散
imitation.sentence_en: Families fled their homes as the wildfire approached.
imitation.translation_zh: 随着山火逼近，许多家庭逃离家园。

context.zh: 逃离了他们的家园

items.example: The judgment could prove largely symbolic if enforcement remains out of reach.
items.analysis_zh: prove symbolic 表示结果最终显现为象征意义，prove 在这里是系动词，后接形容词。could 和 if 同时限制结论，说明执行困难可能削弱实际效果，不能断言裁决完全无用。与 practical 相比，symbolic 强调法律或政治表态层面的影响。
items.cloze: The judgment could prove largely ______ if enforcement remains out of reach.
items.why_zh: prove largely symbolic 在本句中表示“最终可能主要具有象征意义”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目签约缺乏执行措施
imitation.sentence_en: Without a delivery plan, the agreement may prove largely symbolic.
imitation.translation_zh: 如果没有交付计划，这份协议可能最终流于象征。

context.zh: 最终可能主要具有象征意义

items.example: Fiona, a well-known hippopotamus at Cincinnati Zoo, died after swallowing a woolly hat that entered her enclosure.
items.analysis_zh: after swallowing 是介词 after 加动名词，表示吞食行为先于死亡发生。这里据动物园所述交代事故经过，不能凭此推断投掷者有意伤害。与 chewing 不同，swallowing 明确表示物体进入消化道；woolly hat 指毛线帽。
items.cloze: Fiona, a well-known hippopotamus at Cincinnati Zoo, died after ______ a woolly hat that entered her enclosure.
items.why_zh: died after swallowing a woolly hat 在本句中表示“吞下一顶毛线帽后死亡”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设提醒宠物主人
imitation.sentence_en: The puppy needed veterinary care after swallowing a small toy.
imitation.translation_zh: 小狗吞下一个小玩具后需要兽医治疗。

context.en: died after swallowing a woolly hat
context.zh: 吞下一顶毛线帽后死亡

items.example: Fiona became famous after being born prematurely in 2017 at an unusually low weight.
items.analysis_zh: be born prematurely 表示在正常妊娠期结束前出生，prematurely 是修饰 born 的副词。这里结合出生体重解释河马受到关注的背景，并未表示早产必然导致其后来死亡。与 early 不同，prematurely 带有医学上早于足月的含义。
items.cloze: Fiona became famous after being born ______ in 2017 at an unusually low weight.
items.why_zh: being born prematurely in 2017 在本句中表示“于2017年早产出生”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设医院发布婴儿护理案例
imitation.sentence_en: The baby was born prematurely and required specialist care.
imitation.translation_zh: 婴儿早产，需要专科护理。

context.zh: 于2017年早产出生

items.example: Her difficult start to life attracted widespread attention on social media.
items.analysis_zh: attract attention 是固定动宾搭配，widespread 修饰 attention 表示关注范围广。这里描述社交媒体上的传播热度，不能推断所有公众都持续关注。与 draw attention 同义；attention 通常作不可数名词，不能写成 many attentions。
items.cloze: Her difficult start to life attracted widespread ______ on social media.
items.why_zh: attracted widespread attention 在本句中表示“吸引了广泛关注”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设摄影作品在网上走红
imitation.sentence_en: The wildlife photograph attracted widespread attention online.
imitation.translation_zh: 这张野生动物摄影作品在网上引起广泛关注。

context.zh: 吸引了广泛关注

passages.title: Anthropic’s debut amid a technology sell-off
passages.body: Global technology investors remained {{2026-11-20-ipo-uneasy}} about artificial intelligence even after Anthropic's enormous stock-market debut. Shares across major Asian and European markets {{2026-11-20-ipo-slipped}} as concerns about valuations spread. Despite the broader sell-off, Anthropic's first-day closing price {{2026-11-20-ipo-valued}} the company at nearly $1.3trn.

passages.title: European response to Moscow’s invitation
passages.body: European leaders {{2026-11-20-ukraine-signalled}} a willingness to discuss a possible end to the war in Ukraine after an invitation from Vladimir Putin. Putin had {{2026-11-20-ukraine-invited}} the leaders to Moscow to clarify their positions on a settlement. Poland's prime minister {{2026-11-20-ukraine-criticised}} the friendly tone of the earlier meeting involving Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.

passages.title: US chip approvals face congressional scrutiny
passages.body: A congressional committee said the administration had {{2026-11-20-chips-approved}} exports of advanced chips to firms linked by the Pentagon to China's military. A short-seller separately {{2026-11-20-chips-alleged}} that restricted Chinese organisations could still obtain AMD technology. AMD {{2026-11-20-chips-denied}} wrongdoing as its shares fell following the allegations.

passages.title: Senate rejects a measure on the Iran conflict
passages.body: The US Senate {{2026-11-20-iran-rejected}} a proposal intended to restrict the president's conduct of the war in Iran. The measure would {{2026-11-20-iran-require}} either an end to hostilities or explicit congressional approval for continuing them. Critics argued that the administration had largely {{2026-11-20-iran-bypassed}} lawmakers when pursuing the conflict.

passages.title: El Salvador’s president seeks another term
passages.body: President Nayib Bukele announced his {{2026-11-20-salvador-candidacy}} for a third term in El Salvador. Constitutional changes under his government {{2026-11-20-salvador-removed}} the previous two-term presidential limit. Although critics describe his rule as authoritarian, some people across the Americas have {{2026-11-20-salvador-admired}} his crackdown on crime.

passages.title: World court rules on the Rohingya atrocities
passages.body: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed {{2026-11-20-myanmar-genocide}} against the Rohingya minority in 2017. Hundreds of thousands of Rohingya {{2026-11-20-myanmar-fled}} their homes and crossed into Bangladesh during the military campaign. The judgment could prove largely {{2026-11-20-myanmar-symbolic}} if enforcement remains out of reach.

passages.title: Cincinnati Zoo mourns a familiar animal
passages.body: Fiona, a well-known hippopotamus at Cincinnati Zoo, died after {{2026-11-20-hippo-swallowing}} a woolly hat that entered her enclosure. Fiona became famous after being born {{2026-11-20-hippo-prematurely}} in 2017 at an unusually low weight. Her difficult start to life attracted widespread {{2026-11-20-hippo-attention}} on social media.
